The recorded after values come from a candidate-tip index-only refresh. RepoWise health is a static signal, not a correctness score or per-test coverage map.

remaining_debt.disposition: All entries are named, owned compatibility debt. Their removal gates require separate reviewed changes; this closeout does not authorize deletion.

known_risks: The checked closeout files change the tree after the implementation assembly tip; the final workstream submission must run just check-all on the closeout-inclusive pristine tree.
All 24 selective closures remain uncertified and every production route remains full; no production CI savings are claimed.
The wire check reports an initial release relative to main because main predates the official v1 bundle; the checked compatibility proof separately compares five immutable historical wire releases.
Thirty-eight cycle exceptions, six outward-boundary exceptions, and eight compatibility facades remain active and owned.
RepoWise reports 4872 untriaged static findings and has no candidate per-test map; its health values are not correctness evidence.
The check-all integration-land recipe still quarantines the known bh-tfapu host-fence integration test; an ordinary unquarantined integration run continues to expose that upstream bd limitation.
Unified-host-daemon Darwin LaunchAgent and persistent Linux systemd-user certification remains release-gated by deferred bh-hxbln.1.
The live-ingress matrix passes its deterministic four cells, but genuine provider smoke remains externally blocked by the current non-runnable/nonconformant baml-harness Codex artifact.
